contracts.title: Homological Whitehead with simple connectivity
contracts.statement: A map between simply-connected CW complexes inducing isomorphisms on all homology groups is a homotopy equivalence;in particular a simply-connected acyclic CW complex is contractible.
conditions: Acyclicity alone without simple connectivity is insufficient.
Requires a map with induced homology isomorphisms;not a claim that arbitrary abstractly equal homotopy groups determine homotopytype.
